Went to checkout and entered the requested details for Ada Lovelace: ada@example.com, 12 Rua Augusta, Lisbon.
Placed the order successfully.
The confirmation page states that order TS-1457 is in and that €17.90 was charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag and opened the bag.
After the items were added, shipping was €4.90 and the total was €49.40.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once.
The bag updated to free shipping with a total of €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason: The requested lowercase code was applied once, but the bag reports it does not work and totals remain unchanged.
scenarios.diagnosis: The bag does not accept the valid promo code when it is entered in lowercase, even though the requested code should reduce this order by €9.10.
scenarios.suggestion: Update promo-code validation to accept the lowercase welcome10 code and recalculate the discount and total to −€9.10 and €81.90.
